nodes.name: react-state-dispatcher.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule advising use of the functional (dispatch) form of useState updaters when the new state depends on the previous value, to avoid stale-closure bugs.

nodes.name: react-state-fallback.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending fallback/derived state values over duplicating data in initialState to keep a single source of truth.

nodes.name: react-state-minimize.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule advising developers to minimize the number of state variables and derive computed values during render instead of storing them redundantly in state.

nodes.name: rendering-no-falsy-and.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule warning against using the `&&` short-circuit pattern with potentially falsy (non-boolean) values in JSX, since it can render stray '0' or empty strings.

nodes.name: rendering-text-in-text-component.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule requiring that raw strings always be wrapped in a `Text` component rather than rendered as bare children, which crashes or misbehaves on native platforms.

nodes.name: scroll-position-no-state.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule advising against tracking scroll position with useState due to re-render overhead, recommending refs or animated values instead.

nodes.name: state-ground-truth.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule stating that component state must represent the actual ground truth of the UI rather than a cached or potentially-stale copy of external data.

nodes.name: ui-expo-image.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending the `expo-image` component over the core `Image` component for better caching, performance, and format support.

nodes.name: ui-image-gallery.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending the Galeria library for implementing image galleries and lightbox/zoom viewing experiences.

nodes.name: ui-measure-views.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule describing correct techniques for measuring view dimensions and layout (e.g. onLayout, measure APIs) instead of unreliable workarounds.

nodes.name: ui-menus.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending native menu components for dropdowns and context menus instead of custom JS-rendered popovers, for better platform fidelity and accessibility.

nodes.name: ui-native-modals.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule advising use of native modal/bottom-sheet presentation APIs over JavaScript-driven bottom sheet libraries for smoother, platform-consistent behavior.

nodes.name: ui-pressable.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending the `Pressable` component over the deprecated `Touchable*` family for handling touch interactions.

nodes.name: ui-safe-area-scroll.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending `contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior` for correctly handling safe-area insets in scrollable views.

nodes.name: ui-scrollview-content-inset.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule recommending dynamic use of `contentInset` on ScrollView to manage spacing around keyboard, headers, and other overlays.

nodes.name: ui-styling.md
nodes.summary: React Native best-practice rule outlining modern styling patterns (e.g. StyleSheet usage, avoiding inline style objects) for maintainable, performant component styling.
